Specification: This module is a small TLA+ example that uses ASSUME statements to have TLC check the truth of simple mathematical and logical formulas. It models no stateful algorithm and introduces no variables; instead, it evaluates propositional logic and elementary set-theoretic identities over constants a through g, booleans, and finite sets. The file demonstrates bounded quantification, logical equivalences, and basic set operators, and defines a helper operator SomeSets as the powerset of {a, b, c, d, e}.
AssumptionNames: \A S, T \in SomeSets : (S \subseteq T) <=> S = (S \cap T)
